This is an idea that will help you find any other discussions across Voat related to the post you're currently viewing.

Say you're viewing a post thread that links to some news article. What if you want to see if there are any other discussions happening elsewhere on Voat about the same article? Or what if you want to see if someone elsewhere on Voat linked directly to the discussion thread you're currently participating in?

When viewing a post thread, on the sidebar you see the usual "Submission Info", "Traffic stats", and "Score" sections showing info about the post. But with this idea, you'll now also see a "Related" section just below that. You'll see a "What Links Here" link that will show a list of all internal Voat posts that link directly to this post entry (provided the sub that internal link comes from isn't private). And you'll also see a "What's Related" link that will show a list of all Voat posts that link to the same URL as this one does.

I created a greasemonkey script to automatically add "What Links Here" and "Similar Threads" links to the sidebar under Submission Info sections. But it has some issues because it relies on Voat search page to find related posts. Hopefully a built-in website feature helping to navigate the web of related posts can be done better than what I created.
